title: QuickLook: free Seer alternative
caption:
Seer charges $15.99 to preview any file with the spacebar. QuickLook does it for free 👀

✅ Select a file, press Space, and photos and videos pop up instantly
✅ Opens zip archives, code files and music too
✅ Reads PDFs, and plugins add Office files and more
✅ No price tag, no license key, no ads

💻 Windows
ℹ️ Seer is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. Some formats, like Office files, need a free plugin

Comment "PEEK" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
